summary: Build practical LMIS, quantification, and inventory control skills for health commodities. Enquire now for a 5-day advanced course.
lede: Health commodities supply chain management coordinates forecasting, procurement, storage and distribution to keep medicines and health products available. For procurement, pharmacy, warehouse and logistics professionals, this course builds practical skills in consumption-based forecasting, min-max inventory control and LMIS reporting. Learners also review capability maturity, interpret performance dashboards and identify distribution bottlenecks to plan corrective action.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who manage health commodities across procurement, storage, distribution, reporting, and service delivery interfaces.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of health commodities operations, inventory records, LMIS reporting, or procurement workflows. Prior experience in supply planning, pharmacy stores, logistics coordination, or health program administration is recommended. Familiarity with Excel or similar spreadsheet tools is helpful for the exercises, but no programming is required. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, with guided practice on assessments, dashboards, quantification tools, and reporting templates.
